business_scope.primary_industry_name: GPS-Sealed Bonded Road Feeder Service for International Airports

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (no sub-state tax distinction; single national commercial registry system)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), in force 2012
Colombia–European Union Trade Agreement (provisionally applied since 2013)
Colombia–Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2005, in force 2007)
Colombia–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 2010)
Bilateral double taxation agreements in force with Spain, Mexico, France, Germany, the United Kingdom, South Korea, Japan, and Switzerland

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Constitution of Colombia arts. 333–335; Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Law 526 of 1999 (creation of UIAF); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Decree 830 of 2021 and DIAN Resolution 164 of 2020 (Registro de Beneficiario Final – mandatory UBO register); UIAF Circular 006 of 2021 (SARLAFT and enhanced due diligence); Decree 1068 of 2015 (administrative AML coordination); Decree 390 of 2016 (Estatuto Aduanero, customs bonded transporter authorization); Law 1437 of 2011 (CPACA, administrative procedure and appeals).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (the beneficial owner register is filed with DIAN and accessible only to state supervisory and law enforcement authorities; it is not a publicly searchable registry)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of each foreign corporate shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry of the country of origin of the shareholder (e.g., Companies House, Registro Público, Handelsregister)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization required for documents originating from non-Hague-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate Power of Attorney appointing the Colombian legal representative (Poder Especial) for pre-incorporation formalities
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of origin, countersigned by the corporate registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization for non-Hague-member jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or proof of capital availability issued by the shareholder's banking institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed banking institution in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization, as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of the national identity documents or passports of all ultimate beneficial owners and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry or notary of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; copies must be certified by a notary in the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI Consolidated List, and Colombian national vigilance lists published by UIAF, Procuraduría General de la Nación, and Contraloría General de la República. PEP identification triggers compulsory enhanced due diligence (EDD), source-of-funds documentation, and heightened transaction monitoring in accordance with UIAF Circular 006 of 2021 and Decree 1068 of 2015; adverse-media and negative-news checks are also required given the customs-bonded transport exposure to trade-based money-laundering typologies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), administered through the Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered address; name homologation is obtained via the chamber's Certificado de Homonimia service under the supervisory authority of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be formed in Spanish or in Latin-alphabet foreign words, provided the chosen denomination is sufficiently distinctive and not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name. For a S.A.S., the name must plainly distinguish the entity and may lawfully carry the 'S.A.S.' suffix. Names must follow Spanish orthographic conventions, must not be purely numerical, and any transliterated foreign term must be presented in Roman characters; the Chamber of Commerce may require a complementary Spanish descriptor where the foreign-language name hinders identification or public notice.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names implying public, state, or sovereign character ('Nación', 'Presidencia', 'Ministerio', 'Gobernación', 'Alcaldía', 'Banco de la República') requiring prior authorization from the competent ministerial authority

Terms reserved for regulated financial, insurance, fiduciary, securities, or cooperative undertakings ('Banco', 'Seguros', 'Fiduciaria', 'Cooperativa', 'Bolsa') subject to prior approval by the Superintendencia Financiera
Colombian geographical denominations ('Colombia', 'Bogotá', departmental names) requiring express authorization from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the corresponding administrative body
Words contrary to public order, public morality, or deceptive as to the actual corporate purpose under Decreto 1074 de 2015
Tokens reproducing a protected trademark or trade name without the written consent of the legitimate owner
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects the requested name, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición before the same chamber within ten working days of notification and, alternatively or subsequently, a recurso de apelación before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, in accordance with Ley 1437 de 2011 (CPACA, arts. 74–84). A justified extension of the name reservation is available upon prior written request before the initial 30-day window expires. The applicant should simultaneously submit alternative distinctive denominations to avoid delaying incorporation. If administrative remedies are exhausted unsuccessfully, judicial review may be commenced before the Consejo de Estado within the statutory limitation period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is administratively acceptable to the Cámara de Comercio for maintaining the registered corporate seat and receiving legal notices; however, it is insufficient for the operational customs authorization required under ISIC 5222. The DIAN mandates a physical operational base for a customs bonded road feeder fleet, including a controlled truck yard, cargo custody facilities, and administrative premises notified in the customs registry. The lawful structure is a registered virtual seat coupled with a fully identified and DIAN-notified operational address located within the authorized customs coverage area.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection by DIAN customs officials within the first 12 months of obtaining the bonded transporter authorization is estimated at 60–70%. This reflects DIAN's annual inspection targeting plans applicable to transportadores aduaneros, the mandatory validation visits under the Operador Económico Autorizado (OEA) framework, and the elevated cargo-compliance scrutiny associated with international airport feeder operations. Incidents involving sealed-cargo discrepancies materially increase the probability of immediate inspection.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Código de Comercio, Libro II, arts. 98–119; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (Sector Comercio, Industria y Turismo), Decreto Único Reglamentario
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Superintendencia de Sociedades for legalization and oversight)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución debidamente autenticado o Escritura Pública, registrado en el Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital; shareholders must fully pay the capital subscribed within two years of incorporation. The incorporators may establish an escrow or bank account deposit mechanism in the bylaws; the amount must be real, reasonable and commensurate with the corporate purpose, not necessarily blocked, but subject to proof of payment for registration purposes.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF SOCIEDAD POR ACCIONES SIMPLIFICADA. The undersigned shareholders and appointed directors adopt this unanimous written resolution. 1. The share subscriptions presented in the incorporation instrument are accepted; each shareholder irrevocably subscribes and pays the subscribed capital as stated in the corporate books; the representative is authorized to open a corporate bank account and manage capital funds. 2. The registered office is fixed at [address], jurisdiction of Colombia, and the statutory agent is designated for service of process. 3. The following officers are appointed: [President] as legal representative and [Treasurer/Secretary]. 4. The legal representative is authorized to execute all documents, filings, and licenses necessary to commence customs bonded trucking operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción / RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed company names to the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES). The registry verifies that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity. Upon approval, the name is reserved for up to 60 days. A certificate of name reservation is issued for inclusion in the incorporation instrument.
required_dossiers: Applicant's identification and power of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, submit a new list of alternative names; or request an administrative review before the same Chamber of Commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of incorporation instrument and payment of capital contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public / Cámara de Comercio competent registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución) in Spanish, ensuring compliance with Ley 1258 de 2008. Each shareholder signs and authenticates their economic and personal data. The subscribed capital must be paid as agreed, with bank deposit or sworn statement of collection; if payment is made in cash or assets, the notary or chamber verifies the permissive evidence.
required_dossiers: Identification documents of each shareholder and legal representative
Draft standalone of the economic contribution schedule
Anti-money laundering background forms (Protección de Datos y SARLAFT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry returns observations, correct the instrument and re-submit within the statutory term; if significant flaws exist, execute a clarifying private document or re-execute the instrument before the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the Chamber of Commerce and issuance of commercial certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over principal domicile
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed, paginated incorporation instrument at the Chamber of Commerce. Pay the registration fee, municipal registry tax, and the notary or transcription fees. Once reviewed, the Chamber issues the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) certificate and enters the company in the company registry book.
required_dossiers: Documentation of payment of commercial registry fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is denied or pending, the legal representative must comply with the missing requirements within the period granted by the Chamber; if rejected erroneously, initiate a reconsideration before the Chamber and ultimately before the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Assignment of NIT and activation of electronic invoicing account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) by presenting the RUES certificate to the DIAN office or its electronic portal. The company is automatically incorporated into the Registro Único Tributario (RUT). Activate the electronic invoicing system (facturación electrónica) and optional electronic signature for future commercial documents.
required_dossiers: RUT application form and supporting jurisdictional proofs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN does not issue the NIT within the SLA, the legal representative may request an expiatory petition and update the supporting documentation; any discrepancy in address or activity must be corrected by filing an amended RUT.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank account opening and capital fund accreditation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banking institution in Colombia; supervised by Superintendencia Financiera
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the registered charter, RUES certificate, NIT, and identification to the selected bank to open a current/checking account in the corporate name. For the paid-in capital, deposit the amounts or transfer assets into the corporate account or notarized explanatory written record. Obtain the account opening certificate.
required_dossiers: Identification and background certification of legal representative and shareholders
Proof of physical office address (utility bill or lease)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the final beneficial owners or source of funds, provide a sworn statement of origin of funds and supporting bank statements; if the bank still rejects, choose another authorized credit institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bylaw book legalization and initial shareholder meeting records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio / Superintendencia de Sociedades
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: prepare the corporate books: shareholder registry (libro de registro de accionistas), board and shareholders minutes book, and private accounting records. Submit the books to the Chamber of Commerce for prior vouchering/sealing. Record the minutes of the first general shareholders meeting that ratifies officers and issued shares.
required_dossiers: Register of shareholders and minutes book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If books are not sealed due to gaps in numbering or lack of legalization, correct the physical formats and return them within the specified term; if the minutes contain errors, issue a clarification minute.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Transporte and Superintendencia de Puertos y Transporte; for customs-bonded cargo terminal operations, an air-cargo customs operator license is issued by DIAN and the airport concessionaire (e.g., OPAIN).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Habilitación para Prestador de Servicios de Transporte Terrestre Automotor de Carga; Licencia de Operación Aduanera como transportador/operador de carga bajo régimen de depósito aduanero

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) depending on project size
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Diagnosis Ambiental de Alternativas for large-scale freight terminal yards; otherwise Category II Environmental Compliance (logistics vehicle depot generally Exempt from a full EIA unless situated near wetland or special protected areas)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Decreto 1076 de 2015 and Resolución 909/1541/2254 of Ministerio de Ambiente: PM10/PM2.5, SOx, NOx, and CO2 for heavy-duty diesel fleets; wastewater to municipal sewer must meet Resolución 2115 de 2007 potable reuse and pH 6.0–9.0, BOD5 < 200 mg/L, TSS < 200 mg/L, and hazardous waste must be handled by licensed gestores under Resolución 840 de 2018.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by Cuerpo de Bomberos Voluntarios for parking/storage terminals; structural load inspections and emergency response plans approved by Dirección Nacional de Bomberos or municipal planning; worker health and safety program registered before Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) and Ministerio de Trabajo under Resolución 2400 de 1979.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official e-services portal: MUISCA (www.dian.gov.co); foreign-trade prior procedures are channelled through the Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The non-resident incorporator or resident legal representative obtains a digital certificate (certificado digital) from an authorized certification authority and pre-registers with DIAN through the VUR/MUISCA portal to obtain a Pre-RUT and provisional NIT. Step 2: Execute the S.A.S. articles of incorporation by private document and register the company with the Cámara de Comercio; the Chamber transmits the data to DIAN and the definitive NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) is issued within 1–3 business days; no minimum capital is required. Step 3: Update the RUT in MUISCA to activate mandatory responsibilities: IVA under 'Régimen Común', electronic invoicing issuer status, withholding agent responsibilities, and ICA retention as applicable. Step 4: Appoint a resident legal representative and file beneficial-ownership details in the RUES/Beneficiario Final registry; non-resident shareholders must obtain their own non-resident NIT for dividend and remittance reporting. Step 5: Complete the e-invoicing 'Habilitación' with DIAN before issuing any invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; the Colombian-resident S.A.S. is taxed at the corporate level at the 35% national income tax rate for FY2023–2025 (Law 2277/2022) on worldwide income; Territorial_Scope: resident companies are subject to worldwide taxation with foreign tax credits and CFC rules; Pass_Through_Eligible: not available in Colombia; Tax_Exempt_Zone: a Zona Franca user entity could elect the special 20% income tax rate and would enjoy certain IVA exclusions for operations physically carried out inside the free-trade zone, although ordinary bonded transits from inland warehouses to airports do not by themselves qualify for Zona Franca treatment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not recognize check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections. Available statutory elections for an S.A.S.: (i) elect the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE)' — an optional combined tax on gross receipts (2%–14.5%) replacing income VAT and ICA components for taxpayers with prior-year gross revenue ≤ 100,000 UVT (≈ COP 4,979.9 million for 2025) and ≤ 50 employees; (ii) elect fiscal consolidation ('declaración consolidada') for a group holding at least 50% of a Colombian subsidiary; (iii) irrevocably claim the export-service zero-rating position under Article 481 E.T. when the service meets the statutory export criteria; (iv) elect the Zona Franca regime upon meeting DIAN/ministry investment and employment requirements; (v) use DIAN's APAs/advance pricing agreements, which are administrative elections rather than entity-classification mechanisms.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA), a national multi-stage value-added tax; municipal ICA (industry and commerce tax) applies separately on gross revenues.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 for legal persons: every S.A.S. is compulsorily a 'responsable del régimen común' and must register in the RUT and obtain the NIT before starting operations, regardless of turnover. The simplified-regime ceiling of 3,500 UVT (≈ COP 174,296,500 for 2025, with UVT 2025 = COP 49,799) applies only to natural persons; corporate entities are excluded from that simplification.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEV) is in force for all B2B/B2C operations; each invoice must be transmitted in real time to DIAN's electronic services (web services/API, SOAP/REST), validated online, and returned with a unique CUFE hash code and QR code; issuance is required at the moment the taxable event is completed, and for export services an export invoice must be issued before the operation is declared to customs. The bonded trucking operator must hold an e-invoicing 'Habilitación' through its own certified software or an authorized technology provider. Transport documents and the electronic cargo manifest are integrated with the Declaración de Tránsito Aduanero, allowing DIAN to cross-check the e-invoice against the customs route and the GPS seal data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility under Article 481 E.T. and Decreto 1625/2016 for 'exportación de servicios': (1) The GPS-sealed road feeder service must be provided to a direct recipient that is a non-resident entity without a permanent establishment in Colombia; invoicing a Colombian freight forwarder or customs agent is exposed to DIAN challenge unless the contract clearly evidences that the service is performed for the foreign cargo owner and used exclusively abroad or in connection with the outward carriage of goods; (2) The cargo must physically leave Colombian customs territory under an approved bonded transit, evidenced by the final Declaración de Exportación (DEX) at the airport of exit; (3) The consideration must be paid in foreign currency from abroad and channeled through the Colombian foreign-exchange market within 180 days; (4) The GPS seal route must exactly match the authorized customs corridor; (5) The electronic export invoice with CUFE must be issued to the non-resident consignee. Meeting these conditions creates a 0% VAT rate and grants the right to offset and refund input IVA through quarterly/annual tax refund applications (exenta con derecho a compensación y devolución).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX)
Bill of Lading (Master/House Air Waybill or multimodal B/L issued to the non-resident consignee)
Inward Remittance Certificate / Certificado de canalización de divisas issued by an authorized bank or exchange house
Factura Electrónica de Venta with CUFE code issued as an export invoice
Declaración de Tránsito Aduanero (T-DTA) and electronic cargo manifest for the bonded road feeder route
GPS seal tracking log (recorded positions and seal integrity) matching the customs-approved corridor
Commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN's post-clearance audits compare the DEX, the electronic export invoice, the T-DTA transit route, the GPS seal log, and the FX channeling certificate. If the physical exit of the goods cannot be verified, or the recipient is found to be a Colombian permanent establishment or agent, DIAN reverses the 0% rate and assesses the full 19% IVA on the invoice value plus monthly retroactive inflation-adjusted interest and the 20% penalty for an inaccurate return under Article 648 E.T.; an unfiled or false export declaration triggers additional customs sanctions. Failure to channel the foreign exchange within 180 days brings the operator under the Banco de la República's foreign-exchange regime (Resolución 8/2024), with administrative fines of up to double the un-channeled proceeds and mandatory surrender of the exchange through the authorized market. Fraudulent documents or knowingly fictitious export invoices constitute criminal tax evasion under Articles 434-A and 434-B of the Código Penal, carrying imprisonment of 6 to 10 years, forfeiture of VAT input credits, cancellation of the e-invoicing 'Habilitación', and disqualification of the legal representative; the limitation period for DIAN extends to 10 years if the RUT responsibility has not been updated.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (BANREP), with the Comité de Cambios (Foreign Exchange Committee) as the regulatory rule-setting body; foreign-exchange intermediation and anti-money-laundering compliance are supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso operates under a managed floating exchange-rate regime. Current-account transactions, including ordinary trade, airport feeder services, and transportation payments, are freely convertible through authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries with minimal documentary friction. Capital-account transactions, including inbound equity injections from the foreign S.A.S. shareholders, are also convertible but must be channeled exclusively through an authorized intermediary and registered as inward foreign investment with BANREP; there is no general prior licensing permission for a standard capital contribution. The practical profit-remittance hurdles consist of maintaining a compliant investment registration, evidencing distributable profits through statutory financial statements, satisfying Colombian corporate formalities, and completing the corresponding tax withholding and local cumulative tax reporting. Dividends and capital repatriation can be remitted through the formal market once the underlying inward investment registration and local tax obligations are fully documented.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods-export proceeds, which would include proceeds from any cross-border bonded trucking service classified as an export under the customs regime, must be canalized through an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary. The export proceeds are subject to mandatory surrender/reintegration to the Colombian foreign-exchange market in 100% of the amount evidenced by the export customs declaration. The statutory canalización window is generally three months from the shipment/export declaration date, with a possible pre-authorized extension of up to three additional months where the exporter applies to Banco de la República before the expiry deadline. Delayed surrender or non-canalization exposes the S.A.S. to administrative fines, mandatory issuance of foreign-exchange sanctions, and adverse credit classification with the local financial system.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for equity injection; Operational Current Account in COP and USD
Capital Escrow Account for foreign investment; Operational Current Account in COP
Operational Current Account in COP and USD; trade-finance clearing account
Operational Current Account in COP; foreign-exchange line and capital-registration support
Operational Current Account in COP; customs-related escrow and payment account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary clearing or treasury rail. Colombia does not recognize a foreign digital electronic-money institution as a regulated financial entity for the operation of corporate bank accounts or for the mandatory canalización of foreign-currency inflows and outflows. Offshore EMIs cannot act as authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries under the Colombian exchange regime and cannot provide the legally required documentation for tax or customs reimbursement. Their only viable supplementary role is as a peripheral payment-integration layer for customer front-ends, but the actual settlement, FX conversion, and customs-related flows must sit with a supervised Colombian commercial bank or a locally licensed financial/technology entity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, physical presence is strongly required for a newly incorporated S.A.S. with foreign directors. The legal representative must appear before a Colombian notary to sign corporate banking documents, or alternatively execute a notarized and apostilled power in favor of a local attorney-in-fact. The managing director and ultimate beneficial owners normally undergo a direct KYC interview, either on site or by recorded videoconference approved by the compliance area, and must present original identification, the duly legalized constitutional documentation, and current RUT. Several tier-one banks may accept a hybrid remote onboarding after document legalization, but they nonetheless mandate an initial physical verification of the signatory or a local proxy because of the supervisory rules on customer due diligence and fingerprint-verified forms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign parent shareholders with an opaque beneficial-owner chain, particularly where ultimate owners have no Colombian residency.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO declaration identifying all natural persons with 5% or more participation; notarized and apostilled parent-company registry certificate; foreign tax residence certificates; passports or national IDs of the ultimate beneficial owners; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements; international background/OFAC/UN list screening result issued by the applicant; and the parent company's audited financial statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated S.A.S. with no operating history and a customs-bonded trucking license still in process.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial registry certificate (Certificado de Cámara de Comercio); legalized bylaws; RUT showing the DIAN customs attribute; detailed business plan for airport feeder trucking; application records for the operating license before the Superintendencia de Transporte and DIAN; fleet ownership or lease evidence; insurance certificates; and a written representation that all operations will be executed only after the statutory customs authorization is issued.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound equity wire originating from a jurisdiction with significant currency-repatriation pressure or delayed customs/transport licensing of the receiving SAS.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Binding corporate board resolutions approving the capital injection; detailed statement of the exact use of proceeds, with proforma invoices for truck fleet acquisition or working capital; the underlying foreign-investment declaration prepared for the bank; prior bank reference letters; source-of-funds confirmation with third-party documentary evidence; valuation report of the target business; and confirmation of the updated corporate registry entry reflecting any capital increase.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed persons (PEP) appearing as shareholder, board member, or legal representative of the S.A.S.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Explicit PEP declaration; enhanced due-diligence and source-of-funds questionnaire; verified identification of the PEP; sworn statement of private/occupational background; senior compliance-committee approval; ongoing transaction-monitoring commitment; and contract clauses confirming that any change in PEP status must be communicated immediately to the bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant routing for an inbound equity injection begins with the corporate approval of the capital increase and the registration of the share issuance. The foreign parent must remit the funds by wire transfer, normally through SWIFT MT103, to the company's operational account at an authorized Colombian intermediary. The instruction must include the beneficiary's Colombian tax ID (NIT), the corporate name of the S.A.S., and a clearly identifiable statement of foreign-direct-investment purpose. Upon arrival, the local bank prepares the mandatory foreign-exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional) and submits the corresponding data to Banco de la República for the inward investment registry. The funds are then available in COP after conversion by the intermediary or are maintained in USD in a permitted foreign-currency account. The bank will require the underlying corporate authorization documents, UBO disclosures, source of funds, RUT, and evidence of the capital injection before accepting the wire; a wire lacking the required investment purpose code will be rejected or held in suspense until the complete investment dossier is presented.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for the bonded truck fleet should use the existing operational account for local COP payments through ACH, the local immediate-payment system (SIP), or PSE-style payment rails when paying Colombian third parties such as fuel, maintenance, toll, and terminal-handling providers. For cross-border procurement of truck assets, spare parts, and airport-related supplies, the appropriate rails are SWIFT MT103 transfers with proper trade-purpose codes and a commercial letter of credit, preferably irrevocable and confirmed, for high-value purchases. In all cases, the disbursement must be accompanied by the relevant tax document, customs import declaration, invoice, and proof of underlying transportation or asset purchase. The local bank will record the operation as an import/export-related FX transaction and will require the import declaration to be filed and cleared by the DIAN within the statutory periods for exchange purposes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD plain-vanilla forward contracts executed through an authorized local intermediary
COP/USD cross-currency swaps to hedge term liquidity in the treasury structure
BANREP-authorized non-deliverable forwards (NDF) settled in Colombian pesos
Collared forwards and forward options used solely for hedging operating cash-flow exposure of the bonded trucking receivables and supply-chain import costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration (Renovación de Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each calendar year covering the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs fines per the Commercial Code and loss of commercial registry standing; two consecutive years of non-renewal lead to administrative strike-off and cancellation of registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing with commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of the fiscal year following the reporting period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing is subject to fines up to 1% of the company's registered capital under Law 222 of 1995; repeated failure leads to cancellation of the commercial registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due between 9 and 19 April of each tax year or as published in the DIAN annual filing calendar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of tax due, increasing at 0.5% per week up to 15%; default interest applies; persistent non-filing can lead to RUT suspension and registration strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual exogenous information report (Información Exógena / SII)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due in May of the following tax year according to the DIAN annual resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to 5% of the value of omitted or inaccurate information; suspension of RUT affects customs and foreign-trade operations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner confirmation (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be filed annually together with the income tax return calendar date established for each entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to report final beneficiaries incurs fines equivalent to 1% of the entity's assets or 5,000 UVT, whichever is higher; may also block RUT renewals

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit and statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) apply when total gross revenue or total assets exceed 5,000 tax value units (UVT), approximately USD 625,000, or when the SAS is a controlling entity or issues securities, in accordance with Law 1314 of 2009 and Decree 2420 of 2015.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS for large entities; IFRS for SMEs for small and medium entities, as incorporated by Decree 2420 of 2015 and subsequent amendments.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every SAS must file an annual beneficial owner confirmation with DIAN and update the Cámara de Comercio registration; any shareholding transfer during the year must be reflected in the annual confirmation and in the company's shareholder register before the deadline.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva)
Register of Final Beneficiaries (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Law 2277 of 2022; applicable to taxable years beginning on or after 1 January 2023; unaltered for FY 2025)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sectoral tax holiday for ISIC 5222 road freight. General permanent incentives: (i) additional 100% deduction for investments in new productive fixed assets per ET Art. 158-3, (ii) deductibility of payroll-related surcharges ... (iii) tax discount of up to 25% for qualifying science, technology and innovation investments. Effective CIT exposure therefore approximates the 35% statutory rate absent those deductions.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_commentary: No statutory time limit (ET Art. 147, as amended by Law 1819/2016); tax losses are offset against future taxable income without an annual cap. Carryback is not permitted.
